result.reason: The grant properly adds Affiliates and contractors and limits termination to an uncured material breach, but the operative restrictions still prohibit disclosure, access, outsourcing, and use by anyone other than Licensee employees, directly contradicting the expanded grant. The redline also omits transferability to an M&A successor and does not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable. Accordingly, it reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback position. The changes are otherwise targeted and retain the Field of Use and other unrelated limitations, but the internal inconsistency materially impairs drafting quality.
